shown_card_text.title: The windows orbit into one stack
shown_card_text.what: Six app windows lift off the desk, float in a ring and stack neatly into one pile. It is one of the general shots you asked for tonight, made from our own graphics.
shown_card_text.why: You asked for more general shots about notifications, screens and weekly limits.
shown_card_text.question: What should happen to this shot?
shown_card_text.recommendation: Use it for many agents, one place to look.
context: It comes with generated sound, which stays labelled until you pick the music.
